explication: Apache Kafka is a distributed event-streaming platform: applications produce and consume records through brokers, while administrators manage topics, groups, configuration, and cluster state. This map emphasizes the documented broker and client workflow, group coordination, share-group coordination, and remote log storage, alongside the storage-formatting utility. The excerpts establish some coordinator and storage relationships, but do not show the main client, broker request-dispatch, or replication call paths; those links are therefore omitted rather than inferred.
